response.justification: While Bogdan has extensive full-stack and cross-language experience, there is minimal evidence of deep JVM, Java/Kotlin, or enterprise framework (Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus) expertise — critical for this role. His work centers on TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile apps, with only passing mentions of Java in outdated roles, none tied to IDE tooling or JVM internals.
strengths: Proven experience in developer tooling and IDE-adjacent projects (e.g., CI/CD, test runners)
Strong open-source contributions and technical communication via workshops and talks
Demonstrated ability to work across diverse tech stacks and deliver complex systems
concerns: No clear recent or deep experience with Java/Kotlin or Spring ecosystem
Lack of demonstrated work on IDE internals, language servers, or JVM tooling
Primary tech focus is JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang, not JVM-based enterprise tooling
